rows.text: You find yourself amidst a finely wrought underground forge. Howling clangs of hammer on steel echo through the spiraling corridor.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A scholar of Aquila raises his blueprint in the air, comparing it to the half-finished device's form, at times pointing and gesturing at the areas that need improving.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "There should be a lens added here, folded inward, to correct the observational error on the Veil of Evernight."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "And then, I can prove that the entirety of Amphoreus is centered around Aquila, revolving in periodic motion!" The scholar mutters to himself over the thunderous clamor of the forge.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
